loadFailed: Could not load the settings. Nothing was changed.

deviceFiles.labInboxDescription: Results from lab machines that are not attached to a record yet wait in the lab inbox. Discarded results stay there too, and can be restored.
deviceFiles.recentDescription: Every file a lab machine sent in the last 14 days, including ones that could not be read. Open one to see its details. Results not yet on a record wait in the lab inbox, where you attach them.

diagnoses.title: Diagnoses
diagnoses.description: Manage the list of diagnosis tags that can be applied to medical records. Examples: Arthritis, Otitis externa, Hyperthyroidism.
diagnoses.name: Name
diagnoses.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional clinical description for staff reference
diagnoses.deactivateConfirm: Hide this diagnosis from the picker?
diagnoses.deactivateDesc: Existing records that already use it stay unchanged.

managedScanners.title: Managed HID Scanners
managedScanners.description: HID scanners listed here have their input captured exclusively by this app — they stop typing into other windows. Useful for microchip readers that emit chip IDs as keystrokes. Other HID scanners (e.g. POS / barcode) continue to work normally.
managedScanners.addedDesc: Scanner added — Raw Input filter will pick it up immediately.
managedScanners.name: Name
managedScanners.vidHelp: USB VID in decimal (Device Manager → Properties → Details → Hardware IDs).
managedScanners.macOnlyDesc: Raw Input filtering only takes effect on Windows. On macOS this list is editable for parity, but suppression and capture is handled by the existing HID-polling path instead.

detect.title: Detect connected HID devices
detect.showAll: Show all HID devices (not just keyboards/scanners)
detect.help: Lists devices currently attached. Click "Add" on any row to add it to the managed list with VID/PID and name pre-filled. The scan only reads metadata — devices are NOT opened, so other software keeps working normally.
detect.empty: No HID devices found. Plug in your scanner and click Refresh.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: The application snapshots the database (one per day, kept for 30 days) and mirrors stored files to the destination you choose. A backup runs automatically when the app starts and again every 24 hours while it keeps running. Before an update, a separate copy is kept that daily backups never replace.

errors.folderMissing: The backup folder can't be found. Plug in the backup drive, or choose the folder again.
errors.permissionDenied: The app may not write to the backup folder. Choose another folder, or ask support to check its permissions.
errors.diskFull: The backup drive is full. Free some space on it, or choose another folder.
errors.databaseLocked: The database was busy, so the backup could not finish. Try again in a minute.

backupFailed.title: The backup before the update failed
backupFailed.content: The app could not make a backup before updating ({{reason}}). If the update goes wrong, there is no copy from right before it. Update anyway?

messages.installFailed: Failed to install the update. Please try again later.
messages.upToDateDescription: You are running the latest version!

progress.installing: Installing the update. The app restarts by itself when it is done.

updates.lastCheckFailed: The last automatic update check failed
updates.lastCheckFailedDescription: Tried at {{time}}. The app tries again later, or use Check for Updates now.

googleCalendar.title: Google Calendar Integration
googleCalendar.syncDescription: Connect your Google Calendar to send the clinic’s appointments to it. New and changed appointments go to Google. An event cancelled in Google cancels the appointment here; other changes made in Google are not read back.
googleCalendar.syncHint: One-way: clinic appointments are sent to Google Calendar; cancellations in Google come back

messages.connectedDescription: Your Google Calendar has been successfully connected. Appointments will now sync automatically.
messages.authTimeoutDescription: The authorization process timed out after 2 minutes. Please try again.
messages.disconnectedDescription: Your Google Calendar has been disconnected. Appointments will no longer sync.
messages.disconnectFailedDescription: Failed to disconnect from Google Calendar: {{error}}
messages.syncEnabledDescription: Syncing existing appointments to Google Calendar...
messages.initialSyncCompleteDescription: All future appointments have been synced to Google Calendar.
messages.initialSyncFailedDescription: Sync enabled but initial sync failed: {{error}}. You can manually sync using the "Sync Now" button.
messages.syncDisabledDescription: Appointments will no longer sync with Google Calendar.

googleCalendar.reconnectNeeded: Google sign-in expired. Reconnect to keep syncing.
googleCalendar.lastSyncFailed: The last sync with Google Calendar failed
googleCalendar.lastSyncFailedHint: Some appointments may be missing from Google Calendar. Try Sync Now; if it keeps failing, reconnect.

rooms.confirmDelete: Deactivate this room? It stays on past appointments and can be switched back on under Edit.

templates.hint: Picking a template in a record fills its record type, title, description, prescription, invoice lines and diagnoses. A line's price and VAT rate come from the price list when the template is used.
templates.prescriptionPlaceholder: Usual prescription or advice for this visit (optional)
templates.lines: Invoice lines from the price list

clinic.title: Clinic profile

clinic.logoHint: PNG or JPG, at most 2 MB. Printed in place of the logo on documents.
clinic.noLogo: No logo yet. Documents keep their own logo.
